how: The Watch page (#/watch/<match id>) plays a game's YouTube video beside its live statistics. To add a game: copy a line in "games", put the game's match id on the left (the number at the end of its box-score or live-page address) and the YouTube link on the right, then commit. Live links (youtube.com/live/...), normal links (youtube.com/watch?v=...) and youtu.be links all work.
